title: The Confession in the Tower
hook: Harry and Draconia flee the Yule Ball noise, bickering over his jacket and her humiliation, while Filch's wheezing lantern cuts the dark behind them.

beats.camera: Low angle tracking back as they retreat; Filch's lantern light sweeps wall
beats.action: Harry adjusts collar; Draconia kicks wall. Filch emerges wheezing, lantern raised, halting them.
beats.turn: Forced alliance against Filch replaces open hostility.

beats.camera: Two-shot walking; portraits' eyes follow in background
beats.action: Draconia halts, pulls a folded parchment from bodice—sealed with Malfoy crest wax—and shoves it at Harry.
beats.turn: Secret object surfaces: a coded note implicating her father in ingredient smuggling.

beats.camera: Steadicam spiraling up stone steps behind them
beats.action: They climb; a loose step crumbles—Harry catches Draconia's wrist; lumos flares revealing dust-choked air.
beats.turn: New location, physical danger, and first intentional touch.

beats.camera: Wide through arched window; Yule Ball fireworks bloom below
beats.action: Pansy steps from shadow, holding empty vial; sneers 'Father's orders, Draconia.' Vial shatters at her feet.
beats.turn: Side character raises stakes: Pansy knows the meeting and threatens exposure.

beats.camera: Close-up on Harry's face lit by wand; Draconia's reflection in telescope lens
beats.action: Harry reads note by lumos: 'Delivery midnight—tower roof.' He shows her; her panic confirms she lied about 'friend.'
beats.turn: Harry learns Draconia concealed the true recipient: her father's agent.

beats.camera: Handheld, wind whipping robes; clouds swallow stars
beats.action: Cloaked figure Apparates with a crack—snatches note, shoves Draconia backward; Harry lunges, wand raised.
beats.turn: Trust shatters; physical danger arrives; Draconia realizes she was bait.

beats.action: Harry casts 'Arresto Momentum' on falling Draconia, but recoil hurls him onto icy ledge; cloak figure Disapparates with note.
beats.turn: Harry sacrifices safety to save her; evidence lost; both stranded.

beats.camera: Extreme close-up on parchment fragment caught in Harry's frozen fingers
beats.action: Draconia shivering, pulls Harry's collar—reveals a second, identical wax seal on his inner cuff: matching Malfoy crest.
beats.turn: Revelation: Harry carries a twin seal—he's been investigating her family all term.

cliffhanger: Draconia holds up Harry's cuff: 'You've been wearing my family's seal under your sleeve all night. Who are you really working for, Potter?'
